Project: MLA
STORELAB job reference
EKAS Recruitment job reference:
In store interviewing
Mechanics & Method
Process
Methodology
Intercept research in the high and low performing stores featuring the lamb occasion bay.
Process
2 high performing and 2 low performing stores will be selected by MLA for interviews
8 sessions where a researcher will observe shoppers and intercept shoppers during a 4 hour window
3 versions of the interview script will be used for:
Those that shopped from the lamb bay
Those that looked but did not purchase
Those that did not look or interact with the lamb bay but purchased or shopped in the red meat section
Environment
4 Coles stores
Recruitmen
Recruitment targets
Category
Lamb bay
Location
Australia
Respondents
Estimate 20-30 interviews per 4 hour session. Ie estimate. 8x 25 = 200 interviews
Quotas
Over 18
Aim for spread across age groups and genders
INVITING TO PARTICIPATE
